trigger: The constraints are set on a machine whose recorded cloud instance has a different architecture from the one required; architecture is the only characteristic compared.
The named relation does not exist.
The archive fails its reservation: an uploaded archive's hash does not match the prefix the client sent, a downloaded archive's sha256 does not match the reservation's hash.
A lookup by offer URL or UUID that matches no offer.
The import's records carry a negative upload revision.
Creating a user whose name is already taken by an active user.

msg: unit is not in error state
trigger: Resolving a unit whose agent status is not `error`.
A remote unit enters a local peer relation.
Naming a cloud the controller does not know.
Creating a pool whose name is taken.
A model consumes an offer it already consumes, the proxy application for that offer being registered already.
A scale operation sets a negative scale or removes more units than exist.
A Kubernetes pod the infrastructure announced is not one the model asked for (its ordinal is beyond the scale target, or no scale is in progress).
Creating a model with the same name and owner as an existing one.
A manifest base has no name, or is not Ubuntu.
An operation that requires an alive application targets a dying one (adding units, model migration).
A model migration imports a machine whose name the target model already holds.

msg: cannot change a secret permission scope or subject type
trigger: A grant is updated with a different scope or subject type.
A key's comment is the reserved controller key comment.

msg: charm already exists with different size
trigger: The object store already holds a blob under the charm's hash, at a different size.
A lookup by machine UUID or name that matches no machine.
A sequenced charm is given an explicit revision.
The client cannot parse the directive.
Several endpoint pairs match.
Asking for the parent of a machine that is not a container.

msg: You have specified a controller access permission "<level>"...
trigger: A controller level named together with a model or an offer.
The endpoints named for the offer do not all exist on the application.
A constraints write names an invalid container type or a space the model does not have.
Reading the zone of a machine whose cloud instance has no zone set.
A model operation needs the model's credential and none is set.
A status or relation operation targets a unit whose life is dead.
Importing a secret whose backend cannot be identified.
An import's resource origin is neither `store` nor `upload`.

msg: cannot enter scope, unit or relation not alive
trigger: Entering scope with a dead or dying unit or relation.
Marking a machine `dead` while its life is still `alive`.
A hook-state commit expects a life the unit no longer has.
A Charmhub origin carries no architecture.
The dead gate finds units still referencing the application.

msg: user is the last model admin for 1 or more models
trigger: A revoke (or a user removal) that would leave a model without an admin.
A scoped directive on the bootstrap path.
